value.rationale: Correlation across successive reset-terminated excursions directly measures how an unreset viscoelastic bath retains hidden information. The necessary-and-sufficient threshold g>3/[2(m−1)] decides whether changing reset frequency can improve that event memory. The sharp asymptotic time-scale matching r≈gm and 1/(2egm) optimum replace the fixed-rate geometric decay with a quantitative, model-motivated protocol boundary. This is not a routine reexpression of stationary moments.
